text:
mira: FYI customer acme-inc opened a high-severity ticket — after their IdP deprovisioned a contractor, that user still shows up in our RBAC and can call the API. They also saw a KMS error when exporting audit logs. trace: trace-0a1b2c. Repro steps and partial logs below. Anyone on this?

jamie: on it. can you paste the minimal repro curl and the exact KMS error text?

mira: sure — curl we used: 
```curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" \"https://api.redwood.com/v1/orgs/acme/users?scim=true\"```
response snippet shows user with role \"engineer:full\" even though SCIM returned deprovision success. KMS error when they tried to export logs: `AccessDenied: encrypt/decrypt failed for key projects/acme/kms/keys/rdw-key-3`

ana: tagging security — are we seeing any recent key rotations for acme's customer-managed key? if key was rewrapped/rotated in KMS but credentials not updated, exports would fail. also need to confirm audit retention hasn’t been truncated. :eyes:

luis: checking. quick query against provisioning events: `SELECT * FROM scim_events WHERE org_id='acme' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50` shows a deprovision event at 2025-11-02T14:02:10Z (status=success) for uid=svc-contr-123, but later a background job reapplied a role at 2025-11-02T14:04:02Z (job=role-sync, src=legacy-sync). looks like a race — legacy-sync re-added mapping from an old identity store.

jamie: that matches the trace: trace-0a1b2c shows request path `/internal/role-sync` -> `applyRole` -> code path that skips SCIM check if `identity_source=legacy`. we should treat legacy-sync as eventual consistency and block it on deprovision.

mira: customer reports they exported a 7-day audit bundle and hit the KMS error. they need the bundle for a SOC review. immediate ask: can we generate a temporary export (server-side) without CMK, or re-encrypt with fallback key?

ana: short answer: we have a fallback envelope key but it requires an explicit admin op. opening a KMS ticket now to confirm fallback usage policy. if fallback used, we must record the key-usage in audit log.

luis: remediation plan I propose: 1) stop legacy-sync for acme (disable org_id filter) 2) run a one-off job to remove orphaned roles: `POST /internal/admin/orgs/acme/roles/cleanup` 3) trigger audit export re-run using platform fallback key `rdw-audit-fallback` with admin approval. I can run steps 1+2 now in staging and then prod once we have approvals.

mira: please include exact commands I can give to the customer support rep to keep them updated.

luis: commands: 
```bash
# disable legacy-sync for acme
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN\" \
  https://internal.redwood.com/v1/internal/sync/disable \
  -d '{"org_id":"acme","sync_name":"legacy-sync"}'

# cleanup orphaned roles (dry-run)
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN\" \
  https://internal.redwood.com/v1/internal/admin/orgs/acme/roles/cleanup \
  -d '{"dry_run":true}'
```
After dry-run looks good, run with `{"dry_run":false}`.

jamie: also added a quick monitoring alert tweak so any role-applies that happen within 5 minutes of a deprovision event will create an alert (temp rule) — will roll back after 72h.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/role-sync-fix to staging at 2025-11-02T15:10:00Z. CI: passed.

ana: for the KMS side, put this in the ticket: request fallback re-encrypt of the export bundle and audit record of the operation. cc: legal because this is for a SOC export. we need explicit customer consent to rewrap with fallback key.

mira: I'll ask support rep to get written consent from acme. also passing the dry-run cleanup results back here once it completes.

luis: dry-run done — found 3 orphaned role bindings: svc-contr-123 (engineer:full), svc-guest-77 (viewer), svc-temp-9 (engineer:limited). nothing else. ready to proceed when we have 2 approvals (ops + security).

ana: security approves conditional on audit record and customer consent.

jamie: ops approves. please escalate KMS ticket for same-day fallback if customer needs SOC bundle urgently.

mira: thanks team — I'll update the ticket and confirm with customer. action items: (1) get written consent from acme to rewrap export (mira), (2) KMS fallback escalation (ana), (3) disable legacy-sync and run cleanup after approvals (luis), (4) short-term alert rule stays enabled (jamie).

luis: will post prod run logs when done.

mira: closing loop later today, thanks :thumbsup:
